method: Hand-assessed explanation readiness of specific Centro Histórico cells using assertion, spatial visibility, phase chronology and unresolved limitations, NOT citation counts. Does not rewrite existing 2112-cell heuristic coverage matrix.
scope: Centro Histórico / Hospital de Jesús and adjacent Jesús Nazareno; 16x12x11 matrix remains provisional

criteria.substantial: Coherent historical causes and sequence, several independently inspected scholarly/primary sources, confirmed surviving field objects
criteria.developing: Specific dated explanatory sequence and mapped building phases but single-source or access gaps
criteria.sparse: Specific anchored assertion but not enough for self-contained historical explanation
criteria.missing: No reliable evidence found for this intersection; not proof historical material does not exist

cells.explanatory_readiness: Construction phases can be presented chronologically, but original structural features and altered arcade must be differentiated
blockers: Present visitor access to cloisters unknown

cells.explanatory_readiness: Foundation and municipal reference identified; no treatment of patients, caregivers, funding, admission rules or demographic access
Hospital and adjacent church must be narrated separately
blockers: Church building contracts and original patronage not examined

cells.explanatory_readiness: One named Indigenous woman is documented in a catalog but this cannot sustain broad institutional or demographic claims
Repeated subsidence and post-earthquake building changes provide a potential city-environment link; source is one provisional catalog
blockers: No engineering or hydrological analysis linked

cells.explanatory_readiness: Strong continuity-versus-rebuilding interpretive opportunity, but no confirmed visitor access or visible dating of interior features
One dated urban road and building redevelopment link, but architect plans and policy context missing
blockers: No 1934 road construction or Villagrán original plan examined

cells.explanatory_readiness: Clear reported demolition due to street widening but missing urban planning records and ground truth

next_coverage_action: Complete a locational before/after architectural phase diagram from 1934 plans and 1963 street widening records before creating field-walk interpretation
